listed_for_build_unverified.name: Rebuilt photocopier-parts spindle
listed_for_build_unverified.source_line: The owner describes a 10 mm MDF frame, M8 lead screws, NEMA 23 stepper motors, and linear guides recovered from photocopiers. A PC power supply is also listed among the reused parts. The machine's original control approach included an Arduino, but the owner later says a purchased controller replaced it. The thread uses inconsistent four-axis/five-axis descriptions; this dossier therefore does not assign an exact axis/controller configuration beyond noting that the control electronics changed.
